role: PlanetryItems: configurable custom items, rarity glyphs, lore, Minecraft attributes, oxygen, equipment, durability and level/skill requirements.
platform: Paper/Purpur backend plugin, not Velocity, Spigot or Folia.
compatibility: Paper/Purpur26.1.2, Java25, paper-api26.1.2.build.74-stable. No database. All participating backends must share item definitions and language files; persistent item data survives normal item serialization. Optional AuraSkills2.4.0 API, Nexo1.22+ for26.1.2, and PlanetryCore cachedProgress(UUID). Real Nexo/client/Purpur combination requires staging.
integration: Optional Nexo copies visual components and resolves tag_common/tag_uncommon/tag_rare/tag_epic/tag_legendary/tag_mythical glyphs; no source updater identity retained. Optional AuraSkills exposes five skill requirements and nonpersistent wisdom/health/regeneration/toughness/strength bonuses on active usable equipment. PlanetryCore game levels come from cachedProgress, never vanilla XP. Missing/unloaded level sources deny positive requirements. Installed disabled/incompatible NetworkInventorySync denies grants and inventory refresh until isReady(UUID). ItemService API and planetryitems:item_id/durability/oxygen PDC support future plugins. No live installation is automated. Definitions load atomically from recursive items/*.yml or .yaml; legacy root items.yml imports once to items/imported.yml. All admin commands require planetry.admin.items; /pitems info shows complete settings. Public /migrate has a durable per-backend two-hour player cooldown. Join/server-switch and reload migrations wait for Inventory Sync readiness, preserve quantities/remaining durability/foreign PDC/enchantments and remove deleted IDs with named contact-staff notices. Restricted items remain holdable in both hands without native/AuraSkills bonuses; use and armour equip stay blocked. Rarity dictates display-name color; unbreakable items have no counter/Unbreakable tooltip. Requirement denial labels exclude lore prefixes. Migration retains container/bundle contents, book text and stored enchantments. Session-bound automatic retries handle unavailable Nexo sources or insufficient split space. Stale-attribute cursor drags cancel once for safe cursor repair, then holding is allowed. Nexo native <glyph:id> tags and bitmap/colorable/shadow arguments plus <shift:N> work across item names/lore and language templates. MiniMessage target is the viewer/recipient for current native permission checks; older player-aware resolver preferred when available, global for console. Native fonts retained; rarity still owns name color. Missing/disabled/incompatible/empty/throwing glyphs use glyph-fallbacks.<id>, otherwise empty; unavailable shifts are empty. Nexo owns unknown-ID and permission behavior when active. Dynamic values stay literal and fallbacks do not recursively expand Nexo tags.
validation: Java25 mvn -B -ntp clean verify dependency:build-classpath -Dmdep.outputFile=target/test-classpath.txt; python3 scripts/smoke.py target/planetry-items-VERSION.jar, then repeat --without-hooks. Real Paper probes use controlled players/API fixtures, not connected clients or actual Nexo/AuraSkills binaries. Stage real clients, actual optional plugins/resource pack, Purpur and cross-backend transfers. See docs/ACCEPTANCE.md. Issue11 probes include holding/bonus restrictions, info and permission gates, public migration cooldown, readiness-delayed join updates/removal, rarity colors and hidden unbreakable lore; folder/import and text regressions run in unit tests. Glyph regressions cover native argument forwarding, fonts, current/global and older player-aware resolver APIs, missing/disabled/incompatible/failing hooks and safe fallbacks. Packaged Paper probes exercise configured names/lore/messages, viewer forwarding and serialized glyph components with controlled Nexo API fixtures in both integration modes. Context-target and recipient permission isolation regressions model current native APIs; original simple-glyph ItemLanguage API remains compatible.
